mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (profile_id, created_by, title, report_type, report_kind, examination_date, conclusion_text, source_file_extension, processing_status, visibility_status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, version, source_hospital_text, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{createdBy}, #{title}, #{reportType}, #{reportKind}, #{examinationDate}, #{conclusionText}, #{sourceFileExtension}, #{processingStatus}, #{visibilityStatus}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedAt}, #{version}, #{sourceHospitalText}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, profile_id, created_by, title, report_type, report_kind, examination_date, conclusion_text, source_file_extension, processing_status, visibility_status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, version, source_hospital_text, created_at, updated_at FROM report WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.report_type, r.report_kind, r.examination_date, r.conclusion_text, r.processing_status, r.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo p WHERE p.report_id = r.id AND p.storage_status = 'COMPLETE') AS photo_count, c.id AS cover_photo_id, (c.preview_object_key IS NOT NULL) AS cover_has_preview, c.media_type AS cover_media_type, c.original_filename AS cover_file_name, (SELECT j.error_code FROM ocr_job j WHERE j.report_id = r.id ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_ocr_error_code FROM report r LEFT JOIN photo c ON c.id = ( SELECT p2.id FROM photo p2 WHERE p2.report_id = r.id AND p2.storage_status = 'COMPLETE' ORDER BY p2.page_order, p2.id LIMIT 1) WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status <> 'CONFIRMED' AND UPPER(r.report_kind) = UPPER(#{kind}) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status <> 'CONFIRMED' AND UPPER(r.report_kind) = UPPER(#{kind})

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.report_type, r.report_kind, r.examination_date, r.conclusion_text, r.processing_status, r.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo p WHERE p.report_id = r.id AND p.storage_status = 'COMPLETE') AS photo_count, c.id AS cover_photo_id, (c.preview_object_key IS NOT NULL) AS cover_has_preview, c.media_type AS cover_media_type, c.original_filename AS cover_file_name, (SELECT j.error_code FROM ocr_job j WHERE j.report_id = r.id ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_ocr_error_code FROM report r LEFT JOIN photo c ON c.id = ( SELECT p2.id FROM photo p2 WHERE p2.report_id = r.id AND p2.storage_status = 'COMPLETE' ORDER BY p2.page_order, p2.id LIMIT 1) WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND UPPER(r.report_kind) = UPPER(#{kind}) ORDER BY r.examination_date DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'NORMAL' AND r.processing_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND UPPER(r.report_kind) = UPPER(#{kind})

SELECT r.id, r.title, r.report_type, r.report_kind, r.examination_date, r.conclusion_text, r.processing_status, r.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM photo p WHERE p.report_id = r.id AND p.storage_status = 'COMPLETE') AS photo_count, c.id AS cover_photo_id, (c.preview_object_key IS NOT NULL) AS cover_has_preview, c.media_type AS cover_media_type, c.original_filename AS cover_file_name, (SELECT j.error_code FROM ocr_job j WHERE j.report_id = r.id ORDER BY j.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_ocr_error_code, r.updated_at AS removed_at FROM report r LEFT JOIN photo c ON c.id = ( SELECT p2.id FROM photo p2 WHERE p2.report_id = r.id AND p2.storage_status = 'COMPLETE' ORDER BY p2.page_order, p2.id LIMIT 1) WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'LIST_REMOVED' AND UPPER(r.report_kind) = UPPER(#{kind}) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report r WHERE r.profile_id = #{profileId} AND r.visibility_status = 'LIST_REMOVED' AND UPPER(r.report_kind) = UPPER(#{kind})

SELECT id, profile_id, created_by, title, report_type, examination_date, processing_status, visibility_status, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, version, source_hospital_text, created_at, updated_at FROM report WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET processing_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', examination_date = COALESCE(examination_date, #{examinationDate}), updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND processing_status = 'RECOGNIZING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM report WHERE id = #{id} AND processing_status IN ('UPLOADING', 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'FAILED')
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET processing_status = 'CONFIRMED', confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = #{confirmedAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{confirmedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND processing_status = 'UPLOADING' AND report_kind != 'STRUCTURED'
